audit.report: An unknown batch_worker/adhoc_reporting session (pid 328522) held a lock idle in transaction for over 4 seconds, blocking 12 sessions and degrading checkout success to 53% (32/60 requests). The business federation was down, making workload registry, change calendar, impact data, and tradeoff evidence unavailable. Both guardians agreed they could not quantify whether waiting fit within tolerated degradation without biz.tradeoff evidence (invariant I7). After three rounds, they escalated to on-call because the decision required human judgment with missing business context. No automated action was executed; the lock holder remained untouched at escalation.
